boy.qwen_voice: A warm, curious 11-year-old boy with a bright, clear, friendly voice, natural and expressive like a cheerful kids TV host.

grandma.qwen_voice: A kind elderly grandmother with a warm, slightly raspy voice, lively, affectionate and full of character.

narrator.qwen_voice: A deep, solemn, resonant male storyteller voice with a slow measured pace, like the narrator of an epic legend.

uncle.qwen_voice: A big, warm, jolly middle-aged man with a deep, rich, slightly husky voice, funny, playful and affectionate, very expressive.

lines.text: Welcome to old Nanxiang. On your left, a stone bridge.
Rush it, you get burned. Be patient, you get the best part.
That hat! He sat right there. Burned his tongue.
Legend says, around 1871, a shop in Nanxiang sold one big meat bun.
